title: ELCA is the largest independent Swiss IT firm at 2,200-plus experts, an enterprise sale
content:
ELCA Group is recorded as the largest independent Swiss IT firm, 2,200-plus experts across Pully/Lausanne and four further cities, dual-certified with Camunda Silver alongside its Flowable listing. The record's own summary of the consequence is short: enterprise scale.

Independence is worth separating from size, because the two criteria pull in different directions here. Independence is a positive the screen values elsewhere — it is exactly what Truewind lost when VINCI acquired it, and what makes foreign ownership a disqualifier for NTT Data Spain. An independent firm decides its own technology positioning without a parent's alliance framework. But at this headcount the decision still routes through architecture review and alliance management rather than a delivery lead, which is what puts the row at priority 3.

The dual Camunda and Flowable position means the technical seam is the same one the corpus describes repeatedly: orchestration engines that hold process state as mutable, purgeable rows, with no append-only record of what was decided. ELCA has that gap in two platforms and the Swiss financial-sector client base where the question is already funded — which is why this is a deferral on entry cost, not a rejection on fit. Provenance: Flowable Partner Finder, mined 2026-08-18, not imprint-swept.
